summary: QortalApi.js is the shared, non-module API layer loaded first by index.html (before Shared.js and the board files). It defines process-wide globals (userState, adminGroups, adminGroupIDs, nullAddress, baseUrl) and ~85 functions: base64/uid utilities, account/name lookups against the Core REST API with session Map caches, group membership fetches for the MINTER group (694) and the three forum-admin groups, QDN search wrappers (searchSimple over /arbitrary/resources/searchsimple is the one that matters, 29 call sites), encrypted-attachment helpers (DECRYPT_DATA + SAVE_FILE), poll helpers (retrying /polls/votes reads, VOTE_ON_POLL writes), and seven raw group-transaction builders (invite, kick, ban, addadmin, removeadmin, approval, join) that POST to Core, return unsigned bytes, and are then signed elsewhere with SIGN_TRANSACTION and broadcast through processTransaction (POST /transactions/process, X-API-VERSION 2). No QDN identifier is written here; the only identifier literal is the forum prefix 'mintership-forum-message' used by searchAllCountOnly, and services BLOG_POST / MAIL_PRIVATE / FILE_PRIVATE are hard-wired for the forum rooms. Roughly 25 functions are dead (no callers in any other legacy file) and can be dropped from the port; several live ones are unlimited (limit=0) and uncached (fetchMinterGroupAdmins x17 callers, fetchMinterGroupMembers x14, searchAllCountOnly fetch-all loop per forum room).

bugs.description: searchAllCountOnly downloads every message row in a room (100 per request, loop until empty, no cap) just to obtain a count, on every forum room load. Also matches the '-e' variant because prefix=true.

fetchMinterGroupAdmins and fetchMinterGroupMembers use limit=0 and have no cache, yet are called from 17 and 14 sites; several boards call them per card. fetchAllAdminGroupsMembers adds three more limit=0 requests each time.

searchSimple defaults to limit=1500 (effectively unlimited) and is the backbone of every board list; it also returns three shapes (null for empty/non-array, single object when limit===1, else array) so callers cannot distinguish 'no results' from 'error' and must special-case limit 1.

createRemoveGroupAdminTransaction: `const info = getAddressInfo(userState.accountAddress)` is missing `await`, so when ownerPublicKey is omitted `info.reference` is undefined and the builder throws 'Missing required parameters'. Latent today because ARBoard.js always passes ownerPublicKey.

login(): when GET_ACCOUNT_NAMES returns an empty array (account without a registered name) `accountNames[0].name` throws a TypeError, so the intended 'No account names found...' message is never shown.

loadInLineImageHtml always calls DECRYPT_DATA even for public rooms (isEncrypted false); the wasted qortalRequest can reject on plain data, in which case the catch returns undefined and the image silently never renders.

createGroupInviteTransaction takes `reference` from recipientAddress, which both callers set to the INVITEE, not the signing admin. Core currently tolerates a stale/foreign reference, so it works, but the port must either keep this byte-for-byte or deliberately switch to the admin's reference after testing.

fetchAdminGroupsMembersPublicKeys resolves one /addresses/{addr} per member sequentially with no cache, and concatenates minter admins onto the (already deduped) admin-group list without deduping again, so publicKeys passed to encrypt can contain duplicates and nulls (getPublicKeyFromAddress returns null on failure).

fetchPollResults retries a failed /polls/votes read 10 times with backoff (worst case ~32 s per poll, including 404s for non-existent polls) with no UI feedback; several polls on one board serialise into long waits.

Search URLs interpolate query/identifier/name without encodeURIComponent (searchSimple, searchLatestDataByIdentifier, searchResourcesWithMetadata, searchAllResources, searchResourcesWithStatus), so names or queries containing '&', '#', '+' or spaces produce wrong searches.
searchSimple's full urlSuffix contains `prefix=true` twice (hard-coded and `prefix=${prefixOnly}`), so prefixOnly=false is ambiguous / ignored by Core's single-valued query param.

getAddressInfo returns the raw input string for non-matching addresses instead of null, so callers reading `.reference`/`.level` get undefined; getAddressInfoCached memoises that string for the session.

Caches memoise failures permanently: fetchOwnerAddressFromNameCached stores null on a transient error, getAddressFromPublicKey stores null, getNameFromAddress stores the address; pollResultsCache has no TTL so tallies are stale until clearPollResultsCache is called.
fetchGroupInvitesByAddressCached caches [] for 15 s on error and rethrows once; subsequent calls in the window silently return [] so the 'invited' state can flicker off.
Blob object URLs created in base64ToBlobUrl (inline images) and fetchEncryptedImageBase64 are never revoked (memory leak per rendered image).
base64ToHex / hexToBase58 issue GET requests with a body, which browsers reject with TypeError; dead code.
fetchFileBase64 URL has a stray '/' before '?encoding=base64'; dead code.
createGroupBanTransaction's recipientAddress parameter is unused; the reference comes from adminPublicKey.
getUserAddress resolves to undefined (not an error) when GET_USER_ACCOUNT returns a falsy value; callers then pass 'undefined' into URLs.
verifyUserIsAdmin matches forum admin groups by NAME (adminGroups) while member lists use adminGroupIDs; the two arrays must be kept in sync by hand.
Global console.log/warn/info/debug are replaced with no-ops for the whole page (including third-party libs), hiding diagnostics from users and support.
processTransaction returns raw text when the response is not JSON; callers only test truthiness so a Core error string can be treated as success.
GROUP_INVITE comment promises a 10-day default timeToLive but the default is 0 (no expiry); harmless because callers pass it explicitly, but the port must not 'fix' the default.

uxProblems.description: Users without a registered name get an uncaught TypeError on login instead of a clear 'register a name first' message.
Poll tallies can block a board for up to ~32 s per failing poll with no spinner or message.
Inline forum images in public rooms can silently fail to render (see DECRYPT_DATA bug) and show nothing rather than a broken-image state.
fetchAndSaveAttachment swallows every error (console.error only, console silenced), so a failed download gives the user no feedback.
searchSimple returning null for 'no results' and throwing for network errors means boards cannot show distinct empty vs error states.
Because console output is silenced, support cannot ask users for logs.
Balance and name/level lookups fire per card with no batching, so large boards paint slowly on QDN.
